integrity: Mathematical proof is self-contained. Numerical/exact finite checks corroborate but do not establish infinite assertions. No independent audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires arcsine-stationary initial state and ordinary Chebyshev maps of integer degree; restricted to two-symbol single-threshold observations. General nonuniform perturbations are not covered. Relevant 2013 coarse-graining full text could not be inspected, creating residual originality uncertainty.
title: Multiscale threshold correlations and Bernoulli-factor rigidity for Chebyshev maps
